title: RiskRAG: A Data-Driven Solution for Improved AI Model Risk Reporting

bias_targets.methodology: Automated extraction and documentation of gender bias risks and stereotypes from existing model cards and real-world AI incident databases using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework (RiskRAG).

Automated extraction and documentation of racial bias and representational harms from existing model cards and real-world AI incident databases using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework (RiskRAG).

Automated extraction and documentation of language-related limitations (e.g., underperformance on non-English languages) from existing model documents and incident databases using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework (RiskRAG).
